trello.name: Document security ticket injection attempt
trello.desc: Hassan to document the malicious support ticket attempt, including the raw ticket content, the summarizer's partial failure, timestamps, and a severity assessment. This documentation is to be filed in the security log by the end of the week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against injection attacks
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and strips or neutralizes instruction-like content before summarization. This includes creating a regression test using the malicious ticket as a test fixture and adding an evaluation suite to run injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Deadline: not specified, but implied urgency.

trello.name: Investigate password reset email issue for user jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren to verify if the user account jdoe443 exists and check the password reset email delivery logs for the last week. If the account is a burner, close it; if resets are broken, escalate to a new incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan to compile and deliver to Grace a list of all service accounts created since May. Deadline: Thursday before Friday's quarterly access review.
